notes:
62 foods (44 warm, 18 cool, 0 neutral). Structure: two 一覧表 (カテゴリ／食材例) at L41-52 (warm, framed by L40「体を温める食べ物・食材をまとめています」) and L118-125 (cool, framed by L117「体を冷やしやすい食べ物」), then each category repeated one-item-per-line in the body sections (L54-114, L127-153). Table and per-line occurrences are the same items; line_no points at the per-line occurrence with the table line cited in the quote.

Category/umbrella labels coded per instruction: 冬野菜, 根菜類, たんぱく質が多い食材, 肉類, 魚類, 大豆製品, 香味野菜, スパイス, 発酵食品, 寒冷地の果物 (warm); 夏野菜, 南国の果物 (cool). 肉類/魚類/大豆製品 are inline group labels (「肉類：鶏肉、牛肉…」) inside the warm 「たんぱく質が多い食材」 section — flag for adjudication if inline labels are not wanted.

FLAGGED / borderline:
- 赤身肉 and 赤身の魚 (L73): sit inside the warming protein section but the stated reason is 「効率的にたんぱく質がとれる」, not an explicit warming attribution. Coded warm because the section's premise is protein→heat, but this is one inferential step; adjudicate.
- たんぱく質が多い食材: nutrient-based umbrella rather than a food taxon. Verbatim at L45 and L215.
- しょうが vs 生姜: both verbatim (しょうが L48/L80/L87; 生姜 L158/L161/L165/L172/L178/L188/L223). Coded once as しょうが; L172「生姜には体を温める成分「ショウガオール」が豊富に含まれています」 is the strongest explicit warming statement. ねぎ/ネギ same split (ねぎ L48/L82/L100; ネギ L169/L178/L188) — coded once as ねぎ.
- NOT coded (§8 precedent, prepared dishes/beverages rather than a food's nature): 豚汁 (L159/L163「体の芯から温まります」), 味噌煮込みうどん (L160/L167「体を芯から温めてくれる」), 生姜焼き (L161/L171), 味噌汁・お味噌汁・汁物・スープ (L100/L178-180), 「体を芯から温めるお茶」/よもぎ茶 product plug (L195/L203), よもぎ湯入浴パック (L196, not a food).
- NOT coded (no direction stated): ドライフルーツ (L111), お茶 (L87), ポリフェノール/カリウム etc. (nutrients), 香辛料 (only in cited paper titles L90/L191 and the site-wide keyword cloud L340), 玄米/牛乳/大根/アボカド etc. in the unrelated-article lists and keyword cloud (L235-340) — no warm/cool attribution there. Note 大根 appears in the keyword cloud (L323) while だいこん is the coded warm form (L44/L59).
- serving_temperature_items: 冷たい飲み物 (L116, 「冷たい飲み物やアイスを避ける」), 冷たい食べ物 (table category L124 and section L146-147), 冷たい麺類 (L153); warm-side counterparts 温かい料理 (L39/L63), 温かいもの (L153/L221), 温野菜 (L137, preparation not nature). The specific items under the 冷たい食べ物 table row (アイスクリーム/かき氷/サラダ/そうめん/冷やし中華) ARE coded cool as named foods, since the source lists them in the 「体を冷やしやすい食べ物」 一覧表 and states 「生野菜のサラダや冷たい麺類も食べ過ぎると体を冷やします」 (L153) — only the umbrella 冷たい食べ物 is treated as serving temperature.
